# --- header line rules
for hl, ok in [(b'Host: h',True),(b'Host:h',True),(b'Host : h',False),(b'Host',False),
               (b':v',False),(b'H@: v',False),(b'H: \x01',False),(b'H: \x7f',False),(b'H: \x80',False),
               (b'H: ok\tok',True),(b'H:\r',True),(b'\x00: v',False)]:
    raw = request(headers=[hl]) if ok else b'GET / HTTP/1.1\r\n'+hl+b'\r\n\r\n'
    c,_ = rec('e',[('a',raw)])
    check('hdr '+repr(hl), c['error'], None if ok else {'kind':'syntax','offset':0})

# --- host counts
raw = request(headers=[(b'Host',b'a'),(b'HOST',b'b')])
c,_ = rec('e',[('a',raw)])
check('multiple host', (c['requests'][0]['host_count'],c['requests'][0]['host'],c['requests'][0]['flags']),
      (2,fp(b''),['identity','multiple_host','unattributed']))
raw = request(headers=[(b'Host',b'A')])
c,_ = rec('e',[('a',raw)])
check('one host', (c['requests'][0]['host'],c['requests'][0]['host_count']), (fp(b'a'),1))
